description:
I'm Jack Wells. I hung and serviced garage doors for thirty years around
Zanesville, Ohio, and I never met a door yet that was as broken as the
estimate said it was.

This is the side of the trade you don't normally get to hear. Every week I
take one thing in your garage — the opener, the springs, the cables, the
rollers, the safety sensors, the seal along the bottom — and I show you
what's actually wrong with it, what the fix really costs, and when the man
in your driveway is selling you a part you don't need.

No sponsors. No tools I've never used. Just what I'd tell a neighbor who
caught me out front.

• Garage door repairs you can do yourself
• What that callout is really charging you for
• The parts worth buying, and the ones that are a waste
• Openers, springs, cables, sensors, tracks, rollers, seals
• Making the garage itself worth walking into

Door loud, slow, jamming, or the light blinking and nobody can tell you
why? Start here. New video every week.
